description: This file defines the StaticContextService class which provides methods for analyzing and generating code snippets related to static context in an autocomplete system. It includes methods for extracting relevant types and headers, formatting snippets, and managing AST parsing and file system interactions.

classes.name: StaticContextService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to analyze code context, extract relevant types and headers, and generate static code snippets for autocomplete features.

methods.name: logAutocompleteStaticSnippet
methods.description: Logs details of the static snippet context, including hole type, relevant types, and headers.

methods.name: formatAutocompleteStaticSnippet
methods.description: Formats the static snippet context into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Main method to retrieve relevant static snippets based on the current code context, including extracting hole context, relevant types, and headers.

methods.name: getHoleContext
methods.description: Uses Tree-sitter to parse the code and identify the hole's context, including function details and type spans.

methods.name: extractRelevantTypes
methods.description: Recursively extracts relevant type definitions from source code based on a type name.

methods.name: extractRelevantTypesHelper
methods.description: Helper function for extractRelevantTypes, performs AST parsing and recursive type extraction.

methods.name: extractRelevantHeaders
methods.description: Identifies relevant headers and type declarations from source files based on relevant types and hole type.

methods.name: extractRelevantHeadersHelper
methods.description: Helper function for extractRelevantHeaders, performs AST analysis to find matching headers.

methods.name: generateTargetTypes
methods.description: Generates a set of target types for matching, based on the hole type.

methods.name: generateTargetTypesHelper
methods.description: Recursively expands target types by analyzing type nodes.

methods.name: isTypeEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if two syntax nodes represent equivalent types.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a syntax node into a string representation for comparison.

methods.name: insertAtPosition
methods.description: Inserts text into file contents at a specified cursor position.

methods.name: getTypeScriptFilesFromWorkspaces
methods.description: Scans workspace directories to find all TypeScript files.

methods.name: scanDirectoryForTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for files with .ts extension, skipping common directories.
